display.purpose: The single hero metric on a screen (net worth, total balance). Max one per screen.

body.purpose: Default text and primary figures. Prose capped 65-75ch.

mono.purpose: Every amount, points value, and date. Tabular-nums, decimal-aligned.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Interactive-blue focus feedback on inputs, selects, and buttons. The only resting 'glow'.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Entrance reveal — quick ease-out, no overshoot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action everywhere except rewards surfaces. Interactive blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #3B82F6; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2563EB; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Rewards Button
components.description: Honey CTA reserved for points/optimize/reward surfaces only. Never a generic primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-rewards { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #F5B942; color: #0B0C0F; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-rewards:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-rewards:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action; translucent fill, lifts to overlay surface on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #9CA3AF; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #3A3E4A; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #252830; border-color: #4A5060; color: #F0F2F5; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default container. Elevated surface at rest, lifts to overlay on hover via background + border step, not shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1F2229; border: 1px solid #2A2D35; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { background: #252830; border-color: #3A3E4A; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9CA3AF; } .ds-card-figure { font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; color: #F0F2F5; }

components.name: Rewards Card
components.description: Honey-bordered card for points/rewards content only.
components.css: .ds-card-rewards { background: #252830; border: 1px solid rgba(245,185,66,0.18); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-card-rewards .ds-card-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9CA3AF; } .ds-card-rewards .ds-card-figure { font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; color: #F5B942; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Translucent field with a blue focus ring — the interactive signal.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid #3A3E4A; border-radius: 9px; color: #F0F2F5; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; width: 100%; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7280; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(59,130,246,0.20); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.08); }

narrative.overview: HIVE looks like a well-made financial terminal seen in a dark room: an OLED-black field, exact monospaced figures, and a single warm light — honey gold — that switches on only when there is something genuinely rewarding to show. It is a product surface, not a brand surface: the design serves the operator's task and then disappears. Density is welcome; the operator would rather see six real card balances than one smoothed summary. The aesthetic philosophy is comprehension-first — fastest to read, impossible to misread — and identity is carried entirely by accent discipline, typography, and the data itself. The system explicitly rejects the generic AI-dashboard look: Inter everywhere, cyan-on-black neon, a card wrapped around every group, glassmorphism, gradient or glowing text, and a cloned hero-metric template. It also rejects consumer-fintech gamification. This is a shared responsive codebase wrapped for iOS via Capacitor; it must read from iPhone SE width up to Dynamic-Island devices and on desktop web, without forking.
keyCharacteristics: OLED-dark surfaces layered by tone, not shadow (base -> surface -> elevated -> overlay).
Two-color discipline: blue means interactive, honey means rewards. Nothing else earns an accent.
All money is monospaced, tabular, decimal-aligned.
Restrained by default; one dominant element per screen.
Fixed rem type scale on a 3:4 ratio — figures never reflow-jitter across device widths.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Exactly two colors carry meaning: blue = interactive, honey = rewards. Any blue that isn't clickable, or any honey that isn't a reward, is a bug.

rules.name: The Tertiary-Text Ceiling
rules.body: Ink Tertiary (#6B7280) is forbidden for any figure, amount, or decision-critical text — it fails 4.5:1 everywhere. Confine it to timestamps, disabled hints, and icons paired with a label, and never place it on the overlay surface (3.10).

rules.name: The Direction-Plus-Color Rule
rules.body: Money direction and semantic state are never conveyed by color alone. Green/red always ride with a sign, arrow, or label.

rules.name: The Tabular-Money Rule
rules.body: Every monetary figure, points value, and date uses the mono family with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Columns align on the decimal. No exceptions.

rules.name: The No-Inter Rule
rules.body: Body is Plus Jakarta Sans; figures are mono. Inter-everywhere is a generated-UI tell and is prohibited as a body face here.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Convey elevation by stepping the surface token, never by adding a drop shadow. If a component needs to feel raised, move it up the base->surface->elevated->overlay ladder.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Glow exists only for focus feedback and the single top-edge page-hero wash. No glowing text, no glow on resting cards, no neon edges.

dos: Do keep blue strictly interactive and honey strictly rewards — the Two-Signal Rule.
Do render every amount, points value, and date in Geist/JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums, decimal-aligned in columns.
Do build hierarchy in order: white space -> weight -> size -> color -> ornament. Reach for a border or glow only after the first four fail.
Do convey depth by stepping the surface token; lift a card on hover by changing its background, not by adding a shadow.
Do give every screen one dominant element — usually the hero metric or the single decision the screen exists for.
Do convey money direction and state without relying on color: pair green/red with a sign, arrow, or label.
Do use Ink Secondary (#9CA3AF) for secondary text on any surface; it passes 4.5:1 everywhere.
Do meet 44pt touch targets, safe areas, and Dynamic Type from iPhone SE to Dynamic-Island widths — responsively, never as a fork.
donts: Don't use Inter as a body face, or cyan/neon as an accent — both are generated-UI tells.
Don't wrap every group in a card. The card is not the default container; use white space and alignment.
Don't use glassmorphism or decorative blur, and don't proliferate .glass-card on iOS.
Don't use gradient text or glowing text. Glow is reserved for focus rings and the single top-edge page-hero wash.
Don't use a colored border-left stripe (>1px) to denote category or status.
Don't use bounce or springy easing; motion is quick ease-out, <=300ms, and honors reduced-motion.
Don't clone one hero-metric template onto every screen — one earned hero per screen.
Don't put Ink Tertiary (#6B7280) on a figure, amount, or decision-critical text, and never place it on the overlay surface.
Don't justify a choice as 'clean / modern / sleek.' The only rationale is 'fastest to read, impossible to misread.'
